sloka: प्राकृताः तु अकृत आत्मानो लोके क्षत्रिय पांसनाः ।निरर्थकम् विकत्थन्ते यथा राम विकत्थसे ॥३-२९-१८॥
transliteration: prākṛtāḥ tu akṛta ātmāno loke kṣatriya pāṁsanāḥ ।nirarthakam vikatthante yathā rāma vikatthase ॥3-29-18॥

translations.english: O Rama common people, having no control over themselves and the lowest of kshatriyas boast of themselves in the world in a meaningless way as you are doing (now).
